sentences.text:
7 All these Miscellaneous First Appeals are filed by the appellant/Oriental Insurance Company Ltd.,
on the ground that the offending vehicle/Bus bearing registration No.KA- 20/A-4599 is insured with the New India Insurance Company (respondent No.5 herein) but not insured with the appellant/Oriental Insurance Company Limited.
On this ground, these appeals are filed.
2. The factum of accident, injuries sustained by the claimants are not in dispute.

3. Learned counsel for the appellant/Oriental Insurance Company Ltd., submitted that the offending vehicle Bus bearing registration No.KA-20/A-4599 is NC: 2024:KHC:45418 AND 1 OTHER insured with respondent No.5/New India Assurance Company Ltd., as on the date of accident and at the time of accident, the Bus is not insured with the appellant/Oriental Insurance Company.
In the claim petitions before the Tribunal, respondent No.5/New India Assurance Company Ltd. was not made as party.
Hence, it was wrongly fastened burden on the appellant/Oriental Insurance Company.
4. Now in these appeals, the appellant/Oriental Insurance Company has impleaded the New India Insurance Company Ltd. as respondent No.5.
Ex.R-3 is the Insurance Policy which proves that the offending vehicle/Bus is insured with respondent No.5/New India Assurance Company Ltd. and is impleaded in these appeals.

Therefore, accepting the submission of the learned counsel for the appellant/Oriental Insurance Company Ltd., liability is fixed on respondent No.5/New India Assurance Company Ltd. to pay compensation as awarded by the Tribunal.
Therefore, the burden fastened - 10 - NC: 2024:KHC:45418 AND 1 OTHER on the appellant/Oriental Insurance Company to pay compensation is hereby set aside.
Hence, the burden is put on respondent No.5/New India Insurance Company Ltd. to pay compensation to the claimants as awarded by the Tribunal.

5. Hence, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i.
The appeals are allowed.

ii. The impugned judgment and award dated 30.03.2012 passed in MVC Nos.126/2009, 127/2009, 128/2009, 129/2009 and 130/2009 on the file of Additional MACT and Principal Senior Civil Judge, Udupi (common judgment), is modified by holding that respondent No.5/New India Assurance Company shall pay compensation to the claimants as awarded by the Tribunal.
- 11 - NC: 2024:KHC:45418 AND 1 OTHER iii.
The liability fastened on the appellant/Oriental Insurance Company is hereby set aside.

opennyai_summary.facts:
7 All these Miscellaneous First Appeals are filed by the appellant/Oriental Insurance Company Ltd.,
on the ground that the offending vehicle/Bus bearing registration No.KA- 20/A-4599 is insured with the New India Insurance Company (respondent No.5 herein) but not insured with the appellant/Oriental Insurance Company Limited.
2. The factum of accident, injuries sustained by the claimants are not in dispute.
In the claim petitions before the Tribunal, respondent No.5/New India Assurance Company Ltd. was not made as party.
Hence, it was wrongly fastened burden on the appellant/Oriental Insurance Company.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Therefore, the burden fastened - 10 - NC: 2024:KHC:45418 AND 1 OTHER on the appellant/Oriental Insurance Company to pay compensation is hereby set aside.
5. Hence, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i.
The appeals are allowed.
ii. The impugned judgment and award dated 30.03.2012 passed in MVC Nos.126/2009, 127/2009, 128/2009, 129/2009 and 130/2009 on the file of Additional MACT and Principal Senior Civil Judge, Udupi (common judgment), is modified by holding that respondent No.5/New India Assurance Company shall pay compensation to the claimants as awarded by the Tribunal.
The liability fastened on the appellant/Oriental Insurance Company is hereby set aside.
The amount in deposit made by the  appellant/Oriental Insurance Company is  ordered to be refunded to the appellant/Oriental Insurance Company.
